verdict.rationale: Tavily ships a dedicated Extract endpoint that returns web page content for one URL or a batch of up to 20 URLs, with a documented markdown format option. Crawl also includes built-in extraction, so developers can get page content and markdown rather than only search snippets. missing for 10: evidence of raw or full content returned inline with search results (search docs only describe `results[].content`), explicit documentation that extraction returns the complete page text, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can retrieve full page text or markdown for results, not just snippets

citations.quote: Extract web page content from one or more specified URLs using Tavily Extract.
Extract content from one URL or batch up to 20 URLs in one request. Successful URLs appear in results; per-URL failures appear in failed_results.
Tavily Crawl is a graph-based website traversal tool that can explore hundreds of paths in parallel with built-in extraction and intelligent discovery.
